package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const StudentOnboardingProfileVersion = "student-onboarding-v1"

var onboardingCodePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$`)

// StudentOnboarding is the student's declared learning profile. In particular,
// SelfAssessedExperience is an initial hypothesis and never mastery evidence.
type StudentOnboarding struct {
	StudentID              string    `json:"student_id"`
	DirectionCode          string    `json:"direction_code"`
	SelfAssessedExperience string    `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
	KnownStacks            []string  `json:"known_stacks"`
	DesiredStacks          []string  `json:"desired_stacks"`
	GoalCode               string    `json:"goal_code"`
	GoalText               string    `json:"goal_text,omitempty"`
	PreferredLanguage      string    `json:"preferred_language"`
	WeeklyMinutes          int       `json:"weekly_minutes"`
	PreferredPace          string    `json:"preferred_pace"`
	ProfileVersion         string    `json:"profile_version"`
	Version                int64     `json:"version"`
	CreatedAt              time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt              time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

func NormalizeStudentOnboarding(input StudentOnboarding) (StudentOnboarding, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.DirectionCode = normalizeOnboardingCode(input.DirectionCode)
	input.SelfAssessedExperience = normalizeOnboardingCode(input.SelfAssessedExperience)
	input.GoalCode = normalizeOnboardingCode(input.GoalCode)
	input.GoalText = strings.TrimSpace(input.GoalText)
	input.PreferredLanguage = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.PreferredLanguage))
	input.PreferredPace = normalizeOnboardingCode(input.PreferredPace)
	input.ProfileVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.ProfileVersion)
	if input.ProfileVersion == "" {
		input.ProfileVersion = StudentOnboardingProfileVersion
	}
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()

	known, err := normalizeOnboardingValues(input.KnownStacks)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentOnboarding{}, err
	}
	desired, err := normalizeOnboardingValues(input.DesiredStacks)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentOnboarding{}, err
	}
	input.KnownStacks = known
	input.DesiredStacks = desired

	if _, err := uuid.Parse(input.StudentID); err != nil ||
		!onboardingCodePattern.MatchString(input.DirectionCode) ||
		!onboardingCodePattern.MatchString(input.SelfAssessedExperience) ||
		!onboardingCodePattern.MatchString(input.GoalCode) ||
		!onboardingCodePattern.MatchString(input.PreferredPace) ||
		!validLanguageCode(input.PreferredLanguage) || len(input.DesiredStacks) == 0 ||
		input.WeeklyMinutes < 15 || input.WeeklyMinutes > 10080 ||
		!utf8.ValidString(input.GoalText) || utf8.RuneCountInString(input.GoalText) > 500 ||
		input.ProfileVersion != StudentOnboardingProfileVersion || input.Version < 1 ||
		input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.IsZero() || input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) {
		return StudentOnboarding{}, errors.New("invalid student onboarding")
	}
	return input, nil
}

func normalizeOnboardingValues(values []string) ([]string, error) {
	if len(values) > 20 {
		return nil, errors.New("too many onboarding values")
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		normalized := normalizeOnboardingCode(value)
		if !onboardingCodePattern.MatchString(normalized) {
			return nil, errors.New("invalid onboarding value")
		}
		if _, exists := seen[normalized]; exists {
			continue
		}
		seen[normalized] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, normalized)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func normalizeOnboardingCode(value string) string {
	return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
}

func validLanguageCode(value string) bool {
	if len(value) < 2 || len(value) > 16 {
		return false
	}
	for _, current := range value {
		if (current < 'a' || current > 'z') && current != '-' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
